title: parameterCOMP Class
summary: Official Derivative Python API reference for Parameter COMP instances, covering the parameter-dialog minimum width member, lack of operator-specific methods, and inherited PanelCOMP / COMP behavior.
guidance: Use this article when a script needs the Parameter COMP's minimum width before the parameter dialog requires scaling.
The page defines minWidth as the operator-specific member and documents no operator-specific methods.
A parameterCOMP inherits PanelCOMP behavior, so use inherited panel members and methods for panel values, hierarchy, focus, and interaction state.
